summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for the library, aggregating public domain entities, schema definitions, and high-level use case operations to provide a clear and organized API surface for consumers.
responsibilities: Expose the public-facing API surface of the package
Consolidate core schemas and business use cases for external access
Provide unified export points for library functionality
Maintain internal module references to ensure consistent domain access
relationships: The root index acts as a facade that delegates domain responsibilities to the use case and schema modules.
Centralized exports ensure that schema definitions and greeting operations remain discoverable through a single package entry point.
designDecisions: Use of index files to manage and control the public API surface
Re-exporting symbols from internal modules to simplify consumer imports
Aggregation of domain entities and logic into a single organizational hierarchy
